message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; duplicate and obvious naming variants were consolidated. The scan window was **2026-10-09 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-10 07:40 UTC** (**2026-10-09 13:10 IST through 2026-10-10 13:10 IST**).

No confirmed new vulnerability was found that both falls within the strict 24-hour window and maps directly to an exact component in the DLL inventory.

### Possible matches needing review

**Telerik Reporting / CVE-2026-106155**

- **Affected product stated by the vendor:** Progress Telerik Report Server web report viewers before 12.2.26.1007
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 8.9
- **Description:** An authenticated report author can store a `javascript:` or `vbscript:` navigation URL or HTML link that executes in another viewer's browser context, potentially enabling privilege escalation when a higher-privilege user opens the report.
- **Why it may be relevant:** The DLL inventory contains Telerik Reporting 13.2.19.1030, and the vendor describes the flaw as occurring in Report Server web viewers that use the shared reporting engine. However, the CVE's affected-product record names Telerik Report Server, not the standalone Telerik Reporting component, so applicability to the listed DLL cannot be confirmed from public evidence.
- **Freshness:** The CVE record was published on 2026-10-09 at 08:16 UTC, within this run's window.
- **Sources:** [Progress Telerik advisory](https://www.telerik.com/report-server/documentation/knowledge-base/kb-security-improper-neutralization-of-input-cve-2026-106155) and [CVE publication record](https://app.opencve.io/cve/CVE-2026-106155)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official MongoDB libraries and integrations. MongoDB's October 9 Ops Manager records and its October 8 Go Driver and `libmongocrypt` records were checked, but their authoritative CVE publication timestamps precede this run's 07:40 UTC cutoff. Canada's October 9 MongoDB advisory gives no publication time and summarizes the October 8 driver/library disclosures, so it was not treated as proof of a new in-window vulnerability. Sources: [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) and [Canadian Cyber Centre advisory AV26-1024](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/mongodb-security-advisory-av26-1024).

### Review priority

No immediate response is indicated for an exact DLL-list match. A targeted check is recommended to determine whether the deployment also includes Telerik Report Server or its affected web report viewer; if it does, CVE-2026-106155 warrants prompt review because the reported severity is High.
